assumptions.rule: Origin-anchored 200 m clipped blocks with disconnected components stored separately; binary64 coordinates, simple rings without holes. Venues first by place id, then (gx, gy); all venue volumes/Z bands retained. Venue precedence, then cell order on closed boundaries. Venue area is the XY footprint union; stacked volumes count once.

Grid edge neighbours, diagonal second neighbours; venues intersect actual clipped block polygons in XY. Geometry only; traversability unknown. Venue host is the nearest genuinely overlapping block centre by fixed-order squared distance, then cell id.

Clipped block area / district area; no subtraction of venue footprints. Venues have zero residents. S1 rounds headcounts per cell and draws households unchanged; realised household membership can differ.

One vote per distinct person-entry/spot link across phases, retaining cross-community tuples. Affiliation from records, civilian/Unaffiliated merged, NCPD normalized. Exclude vehicle/other/unresolved affiliation. Flat periods (06:00, 12:00, 18:00, 00:00): schedule unknown. Pop distributes the census scale over all cells by votes; empty blocks get 1% of mean block votes (mean 1 if all empty). Empty cells use census affiliation shares. No simultaneous occupancy claim.

One plain-kind table; nearest 15 by fixed-order squared 3D distance to footprint-weighted cell centre, ties by POI id. Market only when a retained POI service has a declared retail vendor type. Unknown kinds counted, never guessed. Evidence pins never become services.

All linked entry types retained; exact (community id, entry name, spot id), deduplicated only across phases of the same entry. Registry ids and ordinals unavailable; no runtime binding. Fallback ids counted by colon format.
Static counts by original POI kind only, separate from S1 fractional coverage. Calibration remains open.
2964, rho, age, role, income, affiliation, household, tenure and wealth marginals, trust and price anchor unchanged. W1 entry counts compare authored types, not quantities.

One named template per kind: block g4, venue v5 (see templates selection rules). Public, A, F and pairs are identical within each kind. Coverage reductions are zero until calibrated; markets come only from POI vendor services. Re-sum district staticTotalA; stub and rest totals unchanged. No claim of measured police/security, propensity, pair hostility or opportunity. S1Data defaults unchanged.
Quantities and period names await a versioned W1 revision. No census flag or schedule interpretation until that contract exists; records/spawners do not supply a census.

report.lineage: Different input content or geometry creates a new lineage. Origin-anchored grid keys are stable; ordinal member ids can shift when earlier cells are inserted.

block.name: g4
block.rule: Median headShare among public, service-free, non-market residential cells without coverage reductions.

venue.name: v5
venue.rule: First non-market stand-in venue in fixture order.
